text:
Alex R: Heads-up — deploy-bot just flagged a rapid rise in 5xxs for the embeddings route during the change window. Not seeing p95 move yet but error rate spiked from 0.12% -> 1.8% in ~3m.

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATION] 4076543208 deploy started: release/2026.03.20-embed-opt. Monitoring SLOs: embeddings.p99_error_rate, embeddings.latency_p95.

Maria S: seeing the same in dashboards — errors concentrated on model-variant v2-quant. Screenshot: https://dash.redwood/embeds/chart?rid=embed-route-err (short link)

Devin T: logs show `ModelLoadError` on several hosts, e.g. 
```
2026-03-20T02:40:12Z host-gpu-12 model_server[pid:4212] ERROR ModelLoadError: checkpoint mismatch for v2-quant
```

Kim L: is that the new quantization path we promoted? I thought we kept v2-quant behind canary.

Alex R: It was enabled for 40% traffic in change window rollout policy. We should scale it back to 0% and pin to v2-fp16 if needed.

Maria S: suggested mitigation: 1) pause rollout and hold traffic 2) route all embed requests to v2-fp16 3) if errors persist, rollback release.

Devin T: I can run the routing pin now. Command: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/route/pin -d '{"route":"embeddings","variant":"v2-fp16"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'`

deploy-bot: [ACTION] pause rollout accepted by Alex R @ 4076543232. Current rollout state: PAUSED.

SRE Bot: Alert muted for embeddings.p99_error_rate for 10m by Alex R to avoid noise while we triage. Remember to unmute if we resume.

Kim L: pin applied, traffic now 100% -> v2-fp16 per API response. Confirming backend logs show successful model loads on hosts that failed earlier.

Maria S: SLOs are trending down. p99 error rate back to 0.15% after ~2m. Latency stable.

Alex R: good. For the release notes and postmortem we should: add note about quant-path gating, escalate to model-onboarding for stricter integration tests, and mark this release as "paused and re-evaluated". I'll draft the note.

Devin T: +1. I'll open a short internal ticket: RM-embed-2026-03-20 for follow-up and include failing host ids and checkpoints.

Maria S: recommend we also add a quick smoke-check to preflight that attempts model load of quant artifacts on a dry-run host. Avoids future surprise.

Alex R: agreed. For now no rollback needed — pin + pause fixed it. We'll only rollback if errors re-emerge after traffic normalization. :thumbsup:

Kim L: leaving conversation for oncall rotation handoff in 10m. I'll include the pin command and ticket link in the handoff message.

SRE Bot: Note: incident timeline recorded. If any team needs the full deploy bot logs, request from #eng-runtime-ops.

Alex R: thanks — closing thread unless anything else pops up.
